summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.88/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.88 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 9, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 15¢ lower than a week ago, 43¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.00 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.65) and the highest in Stevens Point ($4.09).
